sections.name: File setup, RecordValue, object, list, WorkLane, WorkEvent, q
sections.title: Lanes, work lines and small helpers
sections.what: Imports React hooks and defines the three lanes and the shape of a work line. Also defines two helpers that make unknown data safe to read, and a formatter that shows missing values as a placeholder.
sections.why: Likely reason: the shared run view needs one clear shape for every line, and helpers protect it from missing data.
sections.watch_out: The formatter shows any missing value as not recorded, so a real empty value looks the same as a missing one.

sections.name: workEvents, fmt (part 1)
sections.title: Turns saved stage records into timeline lines
sections.what: Reads the saved record of one pipeline stage and produces a plain list of lines describing what was scoped, searched, fetched, read, checked, calculated and concluded. The lines are sorted into three groups, Inputs, Work recorded and Results, and each line can be marked as a warning or failure. Nothing is generated: every line restates a value that is already in the saved record.
sections.why: Likely reason: the page shows the actual steps a run recorded so the owner can see the work behind a result, instead of a summary the software wrote on its own.
sections.watch_out: The lines are built from named fields in the saved record, so if the record's field names change, lines disappear silently rather than raising an error.

sections.name: workEvents, fmt (part 2)
sections.title: Small helper that formats values as text
sections.what: Converts a value into text for the timeline. Text is passed through unchanged, and anything else is formatted as a quoted value. It is used for the reasons a field was held out of a result.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: The helper relies on another helper named q that is defined outside the visible part of this file, so its exact quoting cannot be confirmed here.

sections.name: LANES
sections.title: Names and display limit for the three lanes
sections.what: Defines the three lanes shown on screen, with their labels, and a display cap of 40 entries per lane. The cap keeps long runs from flooding the panel.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps the three lanes in a fixed order and stops very long lists from making the page unwieldy.
sections.watch_out: Each event's lane must match one of these three keys exactly, or that event will not appear in any lane.

sections.name: ObservableWork
sections.title: Viewport that reveals recorded entries
sections.what: Shows the first N recorded entries of a stage, where N is a limit set by the caller. During replay or while a stage is still running, the caller raises the limit over time, so the timeline appears to unfold. The newest visible entry is marked when the stage is being followed. The component has no timers of its own.
sections.why: The header states that replay and live views both use this same component, with timing controlled by the caller.
sections.watch_out: The newest entry is only marked when the following flag is on, so a replay view will not mark a latest line.

sections.name: LaneList
sections.title: Scrolling list for one lane
sections.what: Renders one lane's lines and, while the stage is being followed, scrolls the list to the bottom whenever a new line is added. Only the last 40 lines are drawn.
sections.why: The comment states its purpose: to keep the newest entry in view while a stage is being followed.
sections.watch_out: Only the last 40 lines are drawn, so earlier lines are visible only in the research ledger and diagnostics, as the lane's footer note says.
